title: Teach the worker to conform first and stop authoring evidence
action: The machinery changed in wc-1 and wc-4; workers read text, not source, so the doctrine must now say what the machine does. Edit only the bee-executing skill. Three jobs. FIRST, retire the two rules the machine no longer enforces. worker-details.md:59 says verification_evidence is mandatory for behavior_change cells and that cap refuses without it — it does not refuse any more; it records trace.proof "unrecorded" and warns. worker-details.md:164 and SKILL.md:86-87 say a passing verify recorded without output makes small+ lanes refuse the cap, 'an assertion is not evidence' — the refusal is gone, the JUDGEMENT is not: an assertion is still not evidence, it now leaves a recorded absence that arms the feature close-door instead of blocking the cap. Rewrite both to the new law without softening the judgement, and say plainly that the worker is no longer asked to AUTHOR anything to pass a gate. SECOND, state what did NOT change, because a worker who reads only the loosening will assume everything loosened: red-first still refuses for security and migration in every lane and for behavior, api and bugfix at high-risk (per D2 — and note honestly that refactor and formatting stay suite-green and test stays targeted-green even at high-risk, which is narrower than an 'all classes' reading); the non-empty files_changed door still refuses; the new-test-file rules and the ratio ceiling still refuse; no bypass level lifts any of them. THIRD, add the two conformance habits from D8 that replace the deleted evidence work — the point is to move worker effort from proving to conforming, not to remove effort. (a) A pre-code conformance checklist: read the routed docs, scout adjacent patterns, check for an existing helper before writing a new one, verify the interface contracts the cell names, and cross-check the cell's declared file inventory against what the work actually needs. (b) Three cheap post-edit checks per file: does it compile or type-check, does it match the pattern used by its neighbours, does it introduce an import cycle. Keep both short — they are habits, not a form to fill in. Update references/provenance.md with the decision ids behind every change. Do not touch any other skill and do not touch source. Regen is deferred to the orchestrator at wave close (wave-barrier).

truths: No sentence in bee-executing still tells a worker that cap refuses for missing verification_evidence or for a recorded pass without output
The text states that an absent proof is recorded and arms the feature close-door, not that it is harmless
The surviving refusals are named explicitly, including the honest narrower scope of red-first at high-risk
The pre-code conformance checklist and the three post-edit checks are present and short
provenance.md cites the decision ids behind each change

artifacts.substantive: the retired rules rewritten to the new law, the surviving refusals listed, the two conformance habits added
cap step and red flags consistent with the new law

key_links: every rule the text states can be traced to a live branch in packages/bee/lib/cells.mjs
prohibitions: No edits to any skill other than bee-executing
Do not soften the judgement that an assertion is not evidence
Do not run the regen scripts — the orchestrator owes them at wave close

trace.outcome: bee-executing doctrine restated to the shipped machine: the two retired cap refusals rewritten as a recorded trace.proof "unrecorded" absence that arms the feature close-door (judgement intact — an assertion is still not evidence, and the worker authors nothing to pass a gate); every surviving refusal named and split into both-paths vs pending-deferred; red-first stated at its true narrower scope; D8 conformance habits added; provenance cites D1/D2/D6/D8/D12/D14.
